description: This file defines an abstract class for an Akka actor that handles streaming commands, creating sources of stream elements, batching messages, and managing timeouts.

classes.name: AbstractStreamingActor
classes.description: An abstract Akka actor class that handles streaming commands, creating sources, batching messages, and managing timeouts.

methods.name: getCommandClass
methods.description: Abstract method to return the class type of commands.

methods.name: getBurst
methods.description: Abstract method to extract batch size from a command.

methods.name: getInitialTimeout
methods.description: Abstract method to extract the initial timeout duration from a command.

methods.name: getIdleTimeout
methods.description: Abstract method to extract the idle timeout duration from a command.

methods.name: createSource
methods.description: Abstract method to create a source of stream elements based on a command.

methods.name: batchMessages
methods.description: Method to batch stream elements into a single message, defaulting to the first element if singleton.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Creates the message handling behavior for the actor, matching command types and logging warnings for unexpected messages.

methods.name: startStreaming
methods.description: Handles the start of streaming upon receiving a command, creating a source, batching, and sending a source reference.
